metadata.source: Official Portals of RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, NABARD, SIDBI, NaBFID, EXIM Bank, NHB
metadata.exam_weightage: Extremely High (8-12 Questions across Mains shifts)

institutions.name: Reserve Bank of India
institutions.role: Apex regulator and supervisor of commercial banks, cooperative banks, NBFCs, foreign exchange, money market, and issuer of Indian currency.
institutions.exam_tip: Look out for question on which committee recommended it (Hilton Young) and first Indian governor (C.D. Deshmukh).

institutions.name: Securities and Exchange Board of India
institutions.established: April 12, 1988 (administrative body); Statutory powers granted on January 30, 1992
institutions.governing_act: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (SEBI Act, 1992)
institutions.regional_offices: Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Chennai, and New Delhi
institutions.role: Protects investor interests in securities, promotes the development of and regulates securities markets, stock exchanges, mutual funds, credit rating agencies, and depositories.

institutions.name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
institutions.established: 1999 (as an autonomous statutory body on April 19, 2000)
institutions.governing_act: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999
institutions.recommended_by: R.N. Malhotra Committee on Reforms in the Insurance Sector (1994)
institutions.headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana (shifted from New Delhi in 2001)
institutions.composition: 10-member body (1 Chairman, 5 whole-time members, 4 part-time members appointed by GoI)
institutions.role: Regulates, promotes, and ensures orderly growth of the insurance and re-insurance industries in India.
institutions.exam_tip: Frequently asked trap: IRDAI headquarters is in HYDERABAD (Telangana), NOT Mumbai or Delhi!

institutions.name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
institutions.governing_act: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 2013
institutions.role: Regulates and develops the pension sector in India, administers National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY).

institutions.name: International Financial Services Centres Authority
institutions.governing_act: International Financial Services Centres Authority Act, 2019
institutions.role: Unified regulator to develop and regulate financial products, services, and institutions in the International Financial Services Centres (IFSCs) in India (e.g. GIFT IFSC).

institutions.name: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
institutions.governing_act: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981
institutions.recommended_by: B. Sivaraman Committee (CRAFICARD - Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development)
institutions.ownership: 100% Government of India (RBI divested its remaining shareholding to GoI)
institutions.key_funds_managed: Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF), Long Term Irrigation Fund (LTIF), Micro Irrigation Fund (MIF)
institutions.supervisory_power: Conducts statutory inspections of Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and State/District Central Cooperative Banks under Section 35(6) of Banking Regulation Act 1949.
institutions.exam_tip: NABARD was formed by merging Agricultural Credit Department (ACD) & Rural Planning and Credit Cell (RPCC) of RBI, and Agricultural Refinance and Development Corporation (ARDC).

institutions.name: Small Industries Development Bank of India
institutions.governing_act: Small Industries Development Bank of India Act, 1989
institutions.original_status: Wholly-owned subsidiary of IDBI, de-linked in 2000
institutions.major_shareholders: State Bank of India (SBI), Government of India, LIC, NABARD
institutions.key_subsidiaries: MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency), SIDBI Venture Capital Ltd, SMERA Ratings
institutions.role: Principal financial institution for the promotion, financing, and development of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector.
institutions.exam_tip: High frequency PYQ trap: Headquarters is LUCKNOW (not Mumbai or New Delhi)!

institutions.name: Export-Import Bank of India
institutions.role: Principal financial institution for coordinating the working of institutions engaged in financing export and import trade of India, extends Lines of Credit (LoC) to foreign governments.

institutions.name: National Housing Bank
institutions.recommended_by: High Level Group chaired by Dr. C. Rangarajan
institutions.ownership: 100% Government of India (RBI divested its entire 100% equity stake to GoI in March 2019)
institutions.regulatory_note: Regulatory powers over Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) were transferred from NHB to RBI in August 2019 via the Finance Act (No. 2), 2019; NHB now acts purely as a refinancing and developmental institution.
institutions.exam_tip: HFCs are now REGULATED by RBI, while NHB continues to provide refinancing and supervision assistance.

institutions.name: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development
institutions.governing_act: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development Act, 2021
institutions.ownership: 100% Government of India initially (GoI shareholding will be brought down to 26% over time)
institutions.regulatory_status: Regulated and supervised by RBI as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) under Sections 45L and 45N of RBI Act, 1934.
institutions.role: Dedicated statutory Development Financial Institution (DFI) established to support long-term non-recourse infrastructure financing in India and develop the domestic bond and derivatives market.

institutions.name: Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India
institutions.established: July 30, 1957 (originally Export Risks Insurance Corporation - ERIC)
institutions.role: Provides credit risk insurance covers to Indian exporters against commercial and political risks in overseas markets, and guarantees to commercial banks against losses on export credit loans.

institutions.name: Indian Banks' Association
institutions.members: Public Sector Banks, Private Sector Banks, Foreign Banks, Co-operative Banks, and Regional Rural Banks
institutions.role: Voluntary representative body of Indian banking management. Plays a central role in industry wage negotiations (Bipartite Settlements with bank unions), standardization of banking practices, and policy recommendations to RBI/MoF.

exam_traps.trap: Thinking SIDBI headquarters is located in Mumbai.
exam_traps.fact: SIDBI headquarters is in LUCKNOW, Uttar Pradesh.

exam_traps.trap: Believing IRDAI headquarters is in New Delhi.
exam_traps.fact: IRDAI headquarters was shifted to HYDERABAD, Telangana in 2001.

exam_traps.trap: Assuming NHB still regulates Housing Finance Companies (HFCs).
exam_traps.fact: Regulation of HFCs was transferred to the RBI in August 2019. NHB now acts solely as a refinancing institution.

exam_traps.trap: Believing RBI owns 100% of NABARD and NHB.
exam_traps.fact: Government of India owns 100% of both NABARD and NHB. RBI transferred/divested its entire equity stake in both to the Government of India.
